card.statement:
Let $T(L)$ be a fixed tableau of height $n$.

- [(i)] $\mathcal{B}(T(L)):=\{T(L+z): z\in \mathbb{Z}^{\frac{n(n-1)}{2}}\}$.

- [(ii)] $V(T(L)) = \Span \mathcal{B}(T(L))$.

- [(iii)] For any $T(R)\in \mathcal{B}(T(L))$ and for any $1<p\leq n$, $1\leq s\leq p$ and $1\leq u\leq p-1$ we define:

- [(a)] $\omega_{p,s,u}(T(R)):=r_{p,s}-r_{p-1,u}$.

- [(b)] $\Omega(T(R)):=\{(p,s,u): \omega_{p,s,u}(T(R))\in \frac{1(q)}{2}+\mathbb{Z}\}$

- [(c)] $\Omega^{+}(T(R)):=\{(p,s,u): \omega_{p,s,u}(T(R))\in \frac{1(q)}{2}+\mathbb{Z}_{\geq 0}\}$

- [(d)] $\mathcal{N}(T(R)):=\{T(S)\in \mathcal{B}(T(L)): \Omega^{+}(T(R))\subseteq \Omega^{+}(T(S))\}$

- [(e)] $ W(T(R)):=\Span \mathcal{N}(T(R))$

- [(f)] $U_q\cdot T(R)$: the $U_q$-submodule of $V(T(L))$ generated by $T(R)$
card.label: Notation 14

paper.title: Irreducible subquotients of generic Gelfand-Tsetlin modules over $U_{q}(\mathfrak{gl}_n)$
paper.abstract: We provide a classification and explicit bases of tableaux of all irreducible subquotients of generic Gelfand-Tsetlin modules over Uq(gl(n)) where q different 1 and -1.
